Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Terminate Employment section names; the revoke access, rehire, and payroll eligibility field labels; whether the seniority dates screen still appears; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use this when an employee resigns, including mid pay period. The termination stops pay, and Oracle notifies payroll when it is saved. There's no separate payroll step.

Start from the Quick Action, or search the employee's name and open the action from their record. Both reach the same screen.

Use this whenAn employee resigns.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • The termination stops pay. Don't send a separate payroll request.
  • Open item: the seniority dates screen is no longer editable since Redwood. Skip it for now.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

Voluntary termination

Use when: An employee resigns. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Terminate Employment for the employee.
    • Quick Actions > Terminate Employment > select the employee, or
    • Search the employee's name > Terminate Employment.
  2. Notification date: the day they told you.
  3. Termination date: their last day.
  4. Action: Voluntary separation. Reason: for example, Resigned.
  5. Click Continue.
  6. Revoke access: After termination is standard.
  7. Leave the payroll eligibility field as defaulted.
  8. Last working day: optional. Enter it if known.
  9. Click Submit.

Watch-outs

  • The termination stops pay. Don't send a separate payroll request.
  • Open item: the seniority dates screen is no longer editable since Redwood. Skip it for now.
